services.name: Ultimate 1000 Islands Sightseeing Tour / Including Picnic Lunch
services.desc: Join us for the Ultimate Sightseeing Tour on the St. Lawrence River designed for those who wish to take in the beauty of the 1000 islands Region and experience the the most attractions on the river in an afternoon. Enjoy a Picnic Lunch from Kay's Kitchen and fully licensed bar as you experience our one of a kind intimate tour along the St. Lawrence River through Canadian and US waters in the 1000 Islands. Visit Boldt Castle on Heart Island to explore Millionaire George Boldt's Rhineland Style Castle, cruise "Millionaires Row" to view magnificent summer homes of the rich and famous of the All-Inclusive · 5 Hours · Boldt Castle, Two Nation Boat Tour, Rock Island, Admissions · Picnic Lunch

services.name: Islands, Lighthouses, and Castle Tour
services.desc: 2 Hours About Join us for a two hour tour in the heart of the 1000 Islands on the St. Lawrence River. Our narrator/guide shares history of the area and points out highlights on a 20 mile journey through many of the islands between Clayton and Alexandria Bay. Sights include Boldt Castle on Heart Island, Sunken Rock Lighthouse on Bush island, Rock Island Lighthouse on Rock Island, Million dollar homes, Millionaires Row , and we may even get up close to a Great Lakes Freighter or "Salty" as they travel the Seaway Shipping Channel to/from the Great Lakes and Ports around the world. 2025 2 Hours • All Ages

services.name: Autumn Sunset Cruise in the 1000 Islands
services.desc: Few natural phenomena generate as much excitement as the annual changing of the leaves from bright green to yellows and reds, and the 1000 Islands is no exception! Join us this fall for a relaxing 2 hour cruise on the St. Lawrence River, meandering among the beautiful islands on the St. Lawrence River during Autumn, when the region is burnished in fall colors, and later as the islands are cast in soft hues as the sun sets. The route is captain’s choice to show off their favorite area of the St. Lawrence river and the route may be different every day. This relaxing tour is perfect for The best Autumn views of the 1000 Islands burnished in fall colors and soft hues at sunset

quotes.text: My husband and I had a great time on this trip. We were able to get an up close view of the Thousand Islands. Capt. Jack and Mike were great. They shared a lot of knowledge with us and even more laughs.
The tour was great! The Captain and tour guide were very informative, friendly and funny. I only wish we had more time to explore Boldt Castle. Would definitely recommend the trip and wold come back!
Went on the Boldt Castle two nation tour. Very friendly captain and narrator. The price is very reasonable compared to going from Canadian side. We would definitely recommend this trip to all!!
This trip was well worth it. Our Captain Ron and Tour Guide Ken were both very friendly, knowledgeable, and interesting. The views that we had from this boat were breathtaking.
